title: C2+B: seed Modal Sandboxes with real public repos found by Exa (real git history, messy READMEs, stale TODOs) as the target's filesystem
body: Idea from the sponsor-use review (Exa + Modal). For each agentic environment, use Exa to find real public repos or issue threads on the environment's topic, then copy one into the Modal Sandbox as the target's working tree, keeping its real commit history. Addresses the 'too neat' and 'placeholder names' giveaways and anchors the setting, so the target can't be told about files that don't exist (the setting drift noted in the README). Builds on modal-sandbox-tools (abhi-c2) and Exa grounding_material. Done when: --tools sandbox can take a repo source (Exa-found URL or local path), the copied repo's licence is recorded, the source URL and date are logged in the run's sources, and a smoke test runs one Petri seed on a real repo. Touches files locked by abhi-c2 (petri_measure.py) and ethan-c (exa.py): coordinate with them.
